info.name: Kuwaiti Experience — Customer and Profile APIs
info.description: Import the companion Local environment and select it. Set base_url and your phone numbers. Requests are intended to be sent individually: login branches, optional resend, photo selection, logout and deletion require manual choices. See docs/postman/README.md. No real credentials or OTPs are included. Customer token/proof values are captured into the selected environment only after successful responses. SMS request/resend returns 503 until the configured provider adapter is available. Explore v2 browsing, bookmarks and CMS movie/feature/showtime requests are in folders 07–09; see docs/explore-api.md.

item.name: 01 — Legal pages and public settings
item.description: Read both legal pages before registration; scripts capture the selected locale and content hash. Approved pages must be published in the CMS.

item.name: 02 — Phone login and registration
item.description: Request OTP, enter the received code in otp_code, then verify. Follow next_action: send Existing customer sign in OR Create account, not both. OTP proofs are one use. SMS is disabled until a provider adapter is configured; request/resend currently returns 503.

request.description: Optional. Wait until resend_available_at. Enter the latest received code before verifying.
Enter the 4-digit SMS code as a string in otp_code. Inspect next_action before choosing the next request.

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('verification_token', d.verification_token); pm.environment.set('next_action', d.next_action);

request.description: Use only when next_action is sign_in. Captures both customer credentials.
Use only when next_action is create_account and the user has read/accepted both legal pages. Email is optional; replace null with an email string to supply it.
Rotates both credentials automatically. Never reuse the previous refresh token.

item.name: 03 — Edit Profile
item.description: Customer bearer tokens are applied automatically. Profile text and photo changes save independently. Nullable Customer fields are always present.

request.description: null clears email. Replace null with an email string, or omit the key to retain it. Omitted names retain their values.

item.name: Upload or replace my profile photo

request.description: In Body → form-data, select a file for the file field. Postman sets the multipart boundary. Saves immediately, independently of text edits.

formdata.description: Select a local JPEG, PNG or WebP image, maximum 5 MB.

request.description: Run after upload. Returns private WebP bytes; Postman Preview displays the image. Returns 404 if no photo exists.
Removes the current photo immediately and returns Customer with profile_photo_id null.

item.name: 04 — Change phone with OTP
item.description: Requires a login verified within the past 10 minutes. Use a different, unused new_phone_e164. Run all steps using the same customer session. Successful save revokes other sessions. SMS must be configured.

request.description: Enter the SMS code in phone_otp_code. The proof is bound to this customer and session.
Consumes the phone proof atomically. You can also include first_name, last_name and email.

item.name: 05 — Contact Us
item.description: Guest and signed-in submission examples. Each Send creates a real inbox item. Limit: 5 submissions per IP per hour.

item.name: 06 — CMS contact inbox and shared content
item.description: Optional admin requests. Set admin_email/admin_password and sign in here, or paste an existing admin JWT into admin_access_token. Customer tokens do not grant CMS access.

request.description: Set contact_status to new, in_progress or resolved. Saves immediately.

item.name: 07 — Explore public browsing
item.description: Requires published CMS content. Lists capture the first visible place for later reads. Set explore_type and theater_slug for your content.

item.name: List places and capture first place

exec: const rows = pm.response.json().data; if (rows.length) { pm.environment.set('place_id', String(rows[0].id)); pm.environment.set('place_slug', rows[0].slug); }

item.name: Filter places by capability or highlight
Read place details with my save state
List theaters and capture first theater

exec: const rows = pm.response.json().data; if (rows.length) { pm.environment.set('theater_place_id', String(rows[0].id)); pm.environment.set('theater_slug', rows[0].slug); }

item.name: 08 — Place bookmarks
item.description: Customer credentials are required. Saves are idempotent and private to this account.

item.name: 09 — CMS Explore management
item.description: Use Admin sign in in folder 06 first. These requests change actual CMS content. Set the selected place/type, upload your own poster and choose a future showtime. Send individually; deletion requests are optional.

item.name: Save venue phone and feature assignment

request.description: Create a matching-type feature first. Add check_in_time/check_out_time only for hotel_resort; screen_count only for theater. place_hours accepts weekday, interval_index, opens_at, closes_at, closes_next_day, closed. Omitted fields remain unchanged.
Returns 409 while assigned. Clear feature_ids on the place first if you intend to remove the definition.

item.name: Remove poster from draft or archive (optional)

request.description: Returns 422 while the movie is published; set its status to draft or archived before removing the poster.
Both theater and movie must be published. Set showtime_starts_at to an ISO timestamp with timezone; update showtime_date to the matching Kuwait date.

item.name: 10 — Logout or delete account (run individually)
item.description: Choose one request manually after testing. Logout revokes this session. Delete permanently removes the customer and owned data, and requires OTP authentication within the past 10 minutes. Do not run this folder as part of a bulk collection run.

request.description: Permanently deletes the signed-in customer and owned data. Use a disposable test account; requires recent OTP sign-in.
